feature: Independently checked native integer matrix powers over Q(i)
implementation: One Gaussian Work ledger covers original-source admission, checked inversion for negative exponents, generation, independent replay and final publication.
Right-to-left binary exponentiation with outer-product multiplication proposes the result; left-to-right exponentiation with the existing dot-product multiplication independently checks it.
Negative powers additionally recheck both inverse identities against freshly read original expressions.
Original expressions are admitted even at exponent zero; undefined held children cannot disappear behind the identity result.
The native API and supervised PyO3 bridge support the full signed i64 range subject to the existing Gaussian resource envelope.

cases: Gaussian Jordan and distinct-eigenvalue triangular closed forms
held poles and unsupported original children at exponent zero
source, output and intermediate growth limits
cumulative compute, memory and allocation limits

scope: This commit adds the native implementation and PyO3 bridge. Public dense/sparse Python routing and compatibility tests are a following increment.
